reviews.title: Nice app, but need to allow for cycle reset/stop
reviews.text: The app ui is nice, and lots of great features on plus to help keep you on the pomodoro cycle. However, it doesn’t appear possible to stop or restart a cycle if you need to interrupt. It is also annoying to have the this app stuck on live activities when you are not intending to use it. IE there should be a way to choose when you are in the cycle, when you want to stop it, and when you want to restart. You should also be able to customize cycles for the different tags.

reviews.title: Please enable different break length combos
reviews.text:
This is an excellent app. The design is cute without being distracting. I also posted earlier about wanting alerts that go off even if the watch app is open, but since upgrading to premium, I realized the alarm setting does exactly this! The calendar setting is also super helpful for tracking work! 

The only thing I wish I could do with premium is pair different break lengths to different focus sessions. For example, sometimes I use a 25 min work/5 min break structure, but other times I do 45 mins/10 mins. It would be great if the break time/number sessions before long break switched automatically with my session length instead of having to change it manually.

This is the only study timer app I’ve consistently used for a long time. It’s simple, easy to use, and creates a great study environment. I find myself much more focused and attentive whenever I study with this app.
One suggestion I’d like to make is to add a screen rotation option with a horizontal full-screen mode for phone users, not just iPads and tablets. Having a large, full-screen timer in landscape mode would make the experience even more immersive and motivating for studying.
